Latest message from Wade Wilson:
How much did we spend on cloud in 2025?

response.text:
Cloud is an expense category, so the answer comes from Expenses. That sheet only has dates from Jul 3, 2026, so nothing exists for 2025. Following the rule for a period that starts before the data, the query covers from the first date (Jul 3, 2026) to today, by month. Which expenses count: Rejected ones and ones still waiting on a receipt were not spent, so I count Submitted, Approved and Paid. Submitted expenses aren't approved yet, but they are claims made. To stay close to what was actually spent, I'll count Approved and Paid only.
